Auto-Fire: Hold down Fire button to use Auto-Fire.

notes.title: Version 1.8 Live

Version 1.8 is now live on the default branch and ready to be played.

Achievements

Fear Blaster
Dimensional Shift
Just a Dream

Added critical hit chance to all enemy and player attacks.

notes.title: Version 1.8 Beta Testing
notes.notes:
Version 1.8 Beta Testing

I have been working on the new version 1.8 update. This update will include achievements, new game mechanics, and an updated UI. Live updates are now being sent to the Play-Test branch for beta testing. The update is expected to be finished and live on the default branch by the end of this week.


New Boiler Room Design
New Title Menu UI
Enemy Health Bars (Enable/Disable in Settings)
Damage System with Critical Hits
Three Beginner Achievements

Fear Blaster: Kill one enemy using Fear Blast
Dimensional Shift: Close one inter-dimensional portal
Just a Dream: Awaken from the nightmare one time


To opt into the Play-Test branch, please use the password SlyCatTester.

Thank you for playing,
Tim

notes.title: Version 1.7.2
notes.notes:
Version 1.7.2 Update Notes

New Features / Changes:


Created a new model for the Abandoned Factory.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41252364/0a0956468fd1dd6bec447794c95594c652c2b7a1.png
 
Player Stat - Most Enemies Killed: A count of the highest number of enemy kills in one dream.

Player Stat - Most Portals Closed: A count of the highest number of portals closed in one dream.

HUD: The number of current enemy kills and portals closed during the current dream will be tracked using the player's HUD.

Journal: The bedroom journal will track the Most Enemies Killed and Most Portals Closed stats.

Updated the main font to have a blue glow outline.

Added a camera shake effect on player damage.

Checkpoints: Each time you enter a new room, a checkpoint will be created. There is a confirmation panel when interacting with the bed to start from the last checkpoint or restart from beginning.

Changed the background color of the confirmation panel in the Pause Menu for better visibility.



Bug Fixes:


Portals will spawn enemies correctly even if more than one portal is open.

Enabled interaction with previously found documents in tables.

Enemies will stop their ambient visual effect once killed.

Crosshair will disable while text panels are open.

Game will pause when any text panel is open.

Red Room portal will not trigger right when the player enters the room.

notes.title: Version 1.6.2 Update

Version 1.6.2 Update Notes

New Features:


Enemy Difficulty Settings: There are three difficulty settings to choose from (No Enemies, Normal, Nightmare). This option has replaced the old Disable Enemies option.

Heal Flash: I added a Heal Flash which will flash green on the screen when you have been healed (opposed to the red flash for damage).
If you should use your Restore ability at full Health no flash will appear.

Added a sound effect on Toggle Ability.

There is a new UI Option object which replaces most old options. The new options will allow you to select one of multiple settings for each option. This will make future options much easier to integrate into the settings menu. For instance, I plan to add more options for Crosshair Style in a future update.



Bug Fixes:


Fixed the Player height in Hallway 1F.

Fixed wall colliders in Hallway 1F that were causing issues interacting with objects on the wall.

Increased the size of the new Fall Zone to prevent players from missing it should they fall.

New Features:


Added a new healing ability named Restore. Access your new ability by pressing 'R' or 'D-Pad Up' to toggle between Fear Blast and Restore. {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41252364/1e4d32ac9b8e4f78c289303819d3a50b0ae4bf0a.png
(Notice the Ability Monitor above the Health Bar, it will change colors and text to represent the active ability.)

The enemy waves have been tuned for a more progressive difficulty.

Added a Control Menu to the Intro Scene to help get new players familiar with the controls and let them customize the bindings right away.

Added new cleaner looking UI buttons to the Title Menu with sound effects when selected.

Added a basic Loading Screen UI for all scene transitions.



Bug Fixes:


Resized the wall colliders in all indoor scenes to prevent enemies from pushing you through the walls. Also added a Fall Zone to every scene as a fail-safe that will respawn you in the Bedroom if you fall through.

notes.title: Version 1.4 Update
notes.notes:
Version 1.4 Update Notes

New Features:

Added a new Zombie enemy type that can be found in the Factory and nearby areas.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41252364/131445071854a0ea141adf05044a4975c6c2240d.png
(Shown with Darkness Level set to Off)

Added a new Oil Painting item featuring Midnight that can be found in Chapter 1, it will also appear in the Bedroom once found.

Added a confirmation panel before resetting profile data to keep you from accidentally losing your progress.

Enemy Waves spawn enemies in a wider radius and a Hot Zone indicator has been added to let you know where the enemies are most likely to spawn.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41252364/4775d8d903e7ab43ba852bae6d9e0697ae08f7b5.png
(Shown with Darkness Level set to Off)

Added more Enemy Waves to the Outdoor scene and made some tweaks to the amount of enemies per spawn. This should make the difficulty of the waves more progressive through the scene.

Updated the Bedroom story text to be more descriptive.

Added a tutorial text to the Waiting Room, to help prevent players from running in and dying right away.

Reorganized Credits Panel text objects for easier reading.

Remapped Keyboard Arrow Keys and Controller D-Pad Buttons to work as vertical and horizontal UI navigation.
   NOTE: You may need to Restore Default controls or ensure the actions are mapped to your liking
   if you have already customized the control mappings.



Bug Fixes

Fixed interaction zones on the Interactable Table which was making it difficult to pick items from the drawer.

The game no longer locks up when pressing ESC or Start on a game controller.

Fixed Outdoor scene level borders to prevent players from falling off western border.

Fixed positioning of Hallway 1F architecture that was misaligned,
   including the mysterious 'haunted' table that would move depending on how you look at it.
   
The Profile Manager will find the New Game Panel on game replay as intended.
   
Updated UI button colors for easier navigation. Specifically, the Cancel button on the Load Profile panel was hard to tell whether it was selected due to it's color.
   
Start Tutorial doesn't skip pages when clicking Next or Prev buttons anymore.

Fixed Graphics Menu from failing to open from New Game Menu.

Improved enemy AI, including the Hell Hounds which used to run past or sit there waiting for the player to pet them.

Fixed grammar and whitespace issues in the Start Tutorial.

notes.title: Version 1.1 Quick Fix
notes.notes: Fix for UI issues with v1.1 update.

notes.title: Version 1.1 Content Update
notes.notes:
New Features:

Added new Player ability Fear Blast. Your fear builds as you dream, but you have learned to harness your fear and project it back to your enemies, sending them back to oblivion.
Added new enemy type Blood Golem.


Content Updates:

Added new Player model with partial-body awareness.
Reduced outdoor tree density to allow for better exploration.
Updated outdoor lighting to be darker and create a more realistic night-time experience.
New enemy AI to allow for new wandering enemies.
Improved interaction with Hallway 1F Blocker to appear more realistic.
Moved Hidden Document #1 location.


Bug Fixes:

Player can no longer get stuck between trees and fall into eternity.
Alters will not lock out the player if the key loot has not been picked up before leaving the room.
Interactable Tables will not spawn keys in the drawer if the player already has that key.
Bed surface no longer identifies as water.
Improved UI to work better with lower resolution displays.


Important Note: You might need to reset the controls to the Default mapping or ensure you have Use Ability assigned.
